content.text: Shop, Dine, & Explore Historic Folsom Discover the charm of the Folsom Historic District, where history meets modern living. Stroll through beautifully preserved streets lined with a diverse array of boutique shops, delectable dining, and inviting pubs, wineries and coffee shops. RFP Certified Farmers Market There’s More! With at least one event happening every month, there’s always something to look forward to at the Historic Folsom District! Enjoy concerts at Zittel Family Amphitheater, shopping nights, farmers markets, craft fairs, and dog-friendly, family events that offer fun for all. Explore Historic Folsom Historic Folsom is often termed, “the place where the west came and stayed.” Whether you’re seeking unique gifts, gourmet dining, a historical museum visit, or a cozy spot to unwind, the Folsom Historic District promises an unforgettable experience for every visitor.
